production-single-1.scheduling_note: Boundary scheduling may add a few iterations; report actual counts, not planned-minus-sent as dropped.
limits: Final latency includes DB polling; not exact commit time.
Pending, processing and lag are sampled sequentially and can overlap in-flight; do not sum as exact backlog.
CPU and write counters include observation; no uninstrumented control run.
DB/offset/Relay per-operation time is not measured in this workload; no causal bottleneck attribution.
